content: As Twitter is against polishing this many tweets, Wang et al. provided the tweet ids along with their label. For our experiment, we retrieved the tweets in Wang et al.'s dataset by tweet IDs. As the dataset is from 7 years ago We could only download over 1.3 million tweets from around 2.5M tweet IDs in the dataset. The distribution of the data can be seen in Table TABREF5 .
